name: Cyber Forensic Investigator
title: Cyber Forensic Investigator
intro: From Class 12 Science to a digital-evidence expert: a forensic-science or computer degree, a digital-forensics specialisation, a first analyst role, then senior examiner or incident-response lead.

phases.title: Class 12 Science
phases.summary: PCM keeps both the forensics and computer routes open.
points: PCM leads to B.Tech CSE; PCM or PCB leads to B.Sc Forensic Science.
Some BCA programmes accept Commerce with Maths.
Science is the usual route for this career.

phases.title: Degree
phases.summary: B.Sc Forensic Science, B.Tech CSE or BCA.
points: Pick B.Sc Forensic Science (PCM/PCB), B.Tech CSE (PCM) or BCA.
NFSU is the central university specialising in forensic sciences, including digital forensics.
Learn the IT Act, 2000 — it defines cyber offences and the powers to investigate them.

phases.title: Specialise
phases.summary: An M.Sc in Digital/Cyber Forensics or hands-on training.
points: A specialised M.Sc in Digital/Cyber Forensics or equivalent training strengthens your profile.
Forensics investigates after an incident; ethical hacking tests systems before attackers do — choose your focus.

phases.title: First role
phases.summary: Forensic analyst in a lab, police cyber cell, consulting firm or bank.
points: Labs, police cyber cells, Big 4 forensic teams, banks and cybersecurity firms hire trained graduates.
Government lab posts (scientific officer / assistant in CFSL and state FSLs) come through UPSC and state PSCs; qualifications are in each notice.
I4C, the Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre under MHA, coordinates the national response.

phases.title: Grow
phases.summary: Senior examiner, incident-response lead, expert witness.
points: Growth path: analyst → examiner / consultant → incident-response or forensic lead.
Related fields: incident response, fraud investigation and e-discovery.
Senior examiners may give evidence as expert witnesses.
